reproduction_notes: Create an isolated checkout at baseline_commit; import with the pinned native Windows engine. Apply candidate.patch to reproduce tracked candidate scripts, then copy the committed app/tests/test_control_presentation.gd.

For reference_main.gd take git show baseline_commit:app/main.gd and replace only the legacy EngineSmoke preload with the absolute path of the exact baseline emitter. Use the pinned engine and cpu_probe.gd --subject=<reference or res://main.gd> --output=<fresh JSON>.

Native baseline uses capture_reference.gd with its Main preload adjusted to reference_main.gd. Candidate uses res://tests/capture_engine_smoke.gd. Both take --soundscape=off --scenery=off --birds=off --crash-effects=off and a fresh --out directory.
The native harness source_sha256 reads res://main.gd even for the reference override; reference_main_sha256 and baseline_commit in this record identify the code actually instantiated.

The worktree importer regenerated platform-specific .import metadata and default_bus_layout.tres. These are local import outputs; they were not transferred to the primary checkout. The isolated candidate patch excludes them.
